title: A warm correction changes familiar words

captions.physics: Directly thanking for a clarified meaning
captions.energy: Considering familiar words from another side

meaning: You can directly thank each other for a clarified meaning and consider a familiar reply from another side, experiencing farewell to convenient certainty without abandoning everything previously understood.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Sun in the physical position appears in direct warm gratitude for clarification. The Hanged Man in energy supports a wish to consider a familiar answer from another side. Death in emotions brings farewell to convenient certainty. You can hear another perspective while missing a simple feeling of already knowing what the other person wants. Change concerns a familiar understanding rather than predicting the relationship’s future.

For example, you say, “Thank you, I hear your question differently now”. It emerged that “Tell me as it is” allowed reflection rather than demanding an immediate final assessment. **Another perspective can leave convenient certainty behind**. An answer can become more precise while its familiar prepared meaning disappears. It may be missed because similar words once seemed to need no clarification. This makes neither every earlier reply wrong nor today’s discovery a verdict on the whole past; a side previously unnamed has become visible.

Difficulty arises if unfamiliar understanding prompts returning to the old formula without an actual question. Easy guessing matters more than the distinction heard. The constructive Hanged Man helps retain another perspective without immediately feeling confident. You can value earlier understanding and separately clarify a present request; farewell to a convenient scheme requires neither doubting every word nor finding another universal answer that will never need living conversation again.
